description: An expander for Quad Algorithmic Rhythm, placed immediately to its right, turning each of 18 steps into its own clock divider so a beat fires on some passes and not others.

params.text: Applies these counts to that track of the Quad Algorithmic Rhythm; unlit, the track is left alone.
Sets how many passes of that step go by between firings, 1 to 16; at 1 the beat fires every time the step comes round.
Scales the voltage at that step's divide count input, -100% to +100%, before it is added to the step's own setting.
Inverts that step's count, shown purple: the beat then fires on every pass except the one where the count runs out.
Switches the counts from following steps to following beats, so they apply to the 1st beat, 2nd beat and so on whichever steps those fall on.

inputs.text: Voltage adds to the number of passes between firings of that step, 1.6 counts per volt at full attenuverter.
A trigger inverts that step's count, so it fires on every pass except the one where the count runs out, and a second trigger sets it back.

notes: A QAR Grid Control expander placed immediately to the right of this module replaces the 18 divide counts with the shape drawn in its grid.
